request.deadline: Three-month staged liquidity deployment after enactment with monthly reporting; other delivery deadline not stated in document
deliverables: Shared BTC reserve architecture with reserve-ratio mechanics and safety zones
Composable Cardano-native FIRE and ICE assets
Open-source SDKs and adapters for wallets, DEXs, and DeFi protocols
Always-on public dashboards for reserve ratio, supply, liquidity health, fee flows, and deployment status
Monthly governance reports and reporting standards
Independent security review, audit, and economic modeling
Three-month staged treasury-supported launch liquidity deployment
Legal, compliance, disclosure, treasury reporting, risk documentation, and launch-readiness review
request.recipient: Sundial Protocol and Charms, with Intersect proposed as interim fund administrator subject to confirmation and final agreement.
request.what: Fund and launch Alchemy, a Cardano-native Bitcoin treasury protocol and BTCfi infrastructure layer with reserve architecture, FIRE/ICE assets, dashboards, adapters, reporting, audits, administration, legal/compliance work, go-to-market execution, and staged launch liquidity.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 10,000,000 ada, using an approximate USD 0.20 per ada planning reference for an approximately USD 2.0 million budget split into two approximately USD 1.0 million pools.

Pool 1 would support protocol infrastructure and staged launch liquidity, kept separate from operating spend and deployed in three monthly tranches of approximately USD 250,000, USD 250,000, and USD 500,000.
Pool 2 would fund delivery, audit, integrations, dashboards, governance reporting, legal/compliance work, go-to-market execution, administration, and accounting under itemized planning allocations.
Alchemy would use a shared BTC reserve backing FIRE and ICE, with a reserve-ratio formula, an initial 5.0x target reserve ratio, and safety zones above 4.0x, between 2.0x and 4.0x, and below 2.0x.
FIRE is described as a volatility-absorbing residual BTC-upside asset, while ICE is described as a lower-volatility USD-denominated BTC-backed asset for Cardano DeFi integration.

The proposal states that profits, yield, and returns from treasury-supported launch liquidity will be returned to the Cardano Treasury quarterly, converted into ada through Cardano-native DEXs, and disclosed in monthly reports.

The proposal states that launch-liquidity principal may be returned to the Treasury after Alchemy reaches a 30-day time-weighted average TVL of at least USD 60 million, subject to a later governance proposal.
The proposal asserts that Cardano lacks a production BTCfi infrastructure layer and risks losing Bitcoin-backed structured exposure activity to Ethereum, BNB, Solana, and off-chain markets.

The proposal cites external references for Strategy Q1 2026 results, a Cardano Constitution update, an NCL reference, and an Alchemy simulator as checkable sources relevant to market demand, constitutional framing, budget limits, and modeling.

The proposal acknowledges BTC volatility, oracle, bridge, Charms protocol-layer, novel asset, delivery, and adoption risks, and proposes mitigations including audits, modeling, staged launch, dashboards, pause rules, legal/compliance work, disclosures, milestone gating, fund separation, and administrator oversight.

summary: The document proposes a 10,000,000 ada treasury withdrawal for a Cardano BTCfi infrastructure project by Sundial and Charms, split between staged treasury-supported liquidity and delivery work, with stated reserve mechanics, reporting, administrator oversight, risk controls, and return conditions.
